g.text: Parking in the Terrebonne corridor: modelled automobiles, measured curb, measured private places

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Fill: automobiles registered to each area's households, MODELLED from the SAAQ file of 2024. Orange: legal curb by block face (measured, upper bound).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Green on rue de Terrebonne: each lot's private places, counted from street level on Nov. 12, 2026. Table: the same three, and private places, per area.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Curb: géobase faces less 10 m at each end and stretches forbidden at all times; driveways, hydrants, bus stops, hourly and permit rules not deducted. Private places: cars that can leave

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: without another being moved; garage interiors and the 96 larger buildings' garages not counted; off Terrebonne, the reading of every lot calibrated on 99 lots checked from the street.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Places are capacity, not use: the table does not measure how full the street is.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729), December 31, 2024, type inferred; Statistics Canada, 2021 Census;

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: City of Montréal, géobase, parking-sign inventory and assessment roll (CC BY 4.0). Automobiles below the FSA are MODELLED, not measured.
